finalists.label: Epstein-Barr Virus Encephalitis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence including positive viral capsid antigen (VCA) IgM and diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement along bilateral parietal cortical sulci and around brainstem.

finalists.label: Meningoencephalitis
finalists.why: It accounts for a broad range of symptoms including pharyngeal erythema, stiff neck, altered consciousness, and generalized tonic-clonic seizures.

finalists.label: Viral Meningitis
finalists.why: It is supported by CSF analysis showing leukocyte 250 cells/mm3 and diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement along bilateral parietal cortical sulci and around brainstem.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of positive viral capsid antigen (VCA) IgM and positive EBV DNA in CSF specifically supports Epstein-Barr Virus Encephalitis over other finalists.
